terms.definition: A non-binding result whose status remains visible in the interface and exported artifact.
A versioned, reproducible calculation run containing input, ruleset and benchmark snapshots together with the engine version and output hash.
A named configuration branch whose versions are immutable snapshots.
Cost lines and contributions for a calculation run cover items in the declared scope and are summed as exact money values before display rounding.
The money value reported by PricingSummary for a named Declared Pricing Scope; a missing price is never presented as zero.
The sum of calculated items when PricingSummary is incomplete; excluded, on-request and not-applicable items are reported separately.

forbidden.reason: A share-column heading must identify the reference value of the incomplete PricingSummary.

terms.definition: The qualified net total of a complete authoritative calculation run; its label names the Declared Pricing Scope.

forbidden.reason: A qualified total without a named Declared Pricing Scope promises an unstated scope.

terms.definition: An area value with a mandatory standard reference; the client comparison rate uses above-ground gross floor area only.
Residential floor area under WoFlV; non-normative communal areas are excluded.

forbidden.reason: Areas governed by WoFlV and DIN 277 do not form a shared normative client metric.

terms.definition: Usable floor area under DIN 277, represented as its own area type and as the denominator of a segment rate.

forbidden.reason: Areas governed by WoFlV and DIN 277 do not form a shared normative client metric.

terms.definition: The versioned set of scope items and their coverage decisions; the Declared Pricing Scope equals exactly the items selected as included.

forbidden.reason: A missing benchmark basis does not choose a coverage state automatically.

terms.definition: The catalogue definition, the subject selection and the calculation evaluation are three separate records.
A scope item with coverage, responsibility and provenance, rendered from the same block in the service and interface lists.
The active state reached when the fallback cascade enters its fourth level; assumptions are not stored as separate records.
A separate append-only record that declares a slot disputed without changing the competing values or their sources.
Lower and upper money bounds together with the relative form of the estimate interval; reductions use percentage points and risk remains separate.

forbidden.reason: Only the established production term may identify the estimate interval.

terms.definition: A separate typed record with category, probability, cost impact and affected object; it is not blended into the estimate interval.

forbidden.reason: A risk impact without category, scale and affected object is ambiguous.
